create_SSV2_dataset: create a PyTorch IterableDataset for Something-Something V2 action recognition using frame-based video data
sample_clip_frames: sample frames from a video clip using segment-based uniform or random sampling strategy
read_video_paths_and_labels: read SSV2 video frame paths and labels from CSV and JSON annotation files
iterate_SSV2_clips: iterate over SSV2 dataset clips with configurable clip sampling and optional transforms
configure_SSV2_frame_filtering: configure frame filtering for SSV2 dataset with frames per clip and random sampling options
